title: Cast Private To Array
content: Today I learned that PHP exposes private properties when an object is cast to an array. 🤦.
author: Paul Shryock
code:
<?php

class MyClass {
    private $hi = 'Hi';
    protected $hello = 'Hello';
    public $goodday = 'Goodday';
}

$thing = new MyClass();
print json_encode($thing); // {"goodday":"Goodday"}

print json_encode((array) $thing); 
// {"�MyClass�hi":"Hi","�*�hello":"Hello","goodday":"Goodday"}
